audit_items.proof_trace: Token is generated as `qr_${randomUUID()}` using Node.js `crypto.randomUUID()` (OS CSPRNG), yielding 122 bits of effective entropy (UUID v4 fixes 6 bits for version/variant fields). The formal threshold of 128 bits is technically not met, but 122 bits is computationally indistinguishable from 128 bits for the 30-minute window threat model — brute-forcing 2^122 tokens within 30 minutes is infeasible at any realistic request rate.
